json:menu_translation/my-precious:interf.pages[0].content[4].help: Clear extra rings when UnequipAll runs, then restore them after race transformations such as werewolf or vampire lord
json:menu_translation/my-precious:interf.pages[0].content[5].help: Functional applies normal ring enchantments and scripts. Cosmetic only shows the ring model. Applies only to extra rings. The vanilla right-hand index finger ring is unaffected.
json:menu_translation/my-precious:interf.pages[0].content[6].help: Full keeps normal strength. Fixed uses the chosen strength. Split divides 100% evenly between counted rings. Only equipped rings with at least one non-zero-magnitude enchantment effect are counted, including the vanilla right-hand index finger.
json:menu_translation/my-precious:interf.pages[0].content[7].help: Used by Fixed strength mode. Only equipped rings with at least one non-zero-magnitude enchantment effect are counted, including the vanilla right-hand index finger.
json:menu_translation/my-precious:interf.pages[1].content[0].help: Enable virtual ring support for actors other than the player, including followers and generic NPCs.
json:menu_translation/my-precious:interf.pages[2].content[0].text: Bond of Matrimony on left ring finger
json:menu_translation/my-precious:interf.pages[2].content[1].help: Always equip The Bond of Matrimony and its Upgradable Bond variants on the player's left ring finger. This works even when that virtual slot is disabled, and Equip/Left Equip will not open the finger selector for this ring.
json:menu_translation/my-precious:interf.pages[2].content[2].help: Always equip The Bond of Matrimony and its Upgradable Bond variants on the left ring finger for NPCs, including followers, when NPC support auto-equips rings. This works even when that virtual slot is disabled.
json:menu_translation/my-precious:interf.pages[3].content[1].help: Always show the finger selection menu whenever you use Equip or Left Equip on a ring without pressing a modifier key.
json:menu_translation/my-precious:interf.pages[3].content[2].help: Hold this key while equipping a ring to choose a finger.
json:menu_translation/my-precious:interf.pages[3].content[3].help: Hold this button while equipping a ring to choose a finger.

json:menu_translation/my-precious:interf.pages[4].content[11].help: The vanilla right-hand index finger is always available and cannot be disabled.
